desc:
Displays the claim volume by status for current data set, up to two years. 
•	Placing the mouse over this widget will display the total number of claims per status. 
•	To view information for a specific claim status, select the desired claim status on the widget. The widgets will adjust to reflect information for that specific claim status only. Utilizing filter features will only affect that user’s view.
•	To clear the filter from a widget, select clear selection. To restore the work session dashboard and clear any filters, select the options icon located at the top right corner of the dialog. Select Restore Dashboard. 
Claim Statuses:
ALLOWED- claim has been processed and allowed for payment 
OPEN- claim is open and awaiting review 
FULL DENIAL- claim has been processed for payment and denied 
FULL DENIAL INV- The claim has been denied, has not processed for payment yet 
PAID IN FULL- claim has been processed and paid in full 
PARTIAL DENIAL- claim has been processed and partially denied
PAYMENT PENDING- claim has processed for payment, payment is pending 
SUSPENDED- claim has been suspended for errors to be reviewed 
VOID- claim has been voided, any payment made has been retracted
title: Volume by Status
